title: terragucci.yml
description: One repo's settings, or a control repo's defaults and projects. https://intentius.io/terragucci/reference/config/

roots.description: Globs of root directories. Detected when absent.

binary.description: The binary the pipeline runs. Detected when absent.

version.description: The binary's release, or a map of root glob to release.

generate.description: Backend, provider and version files terragucci generate writes for each plain root.

forge.description: The forge, for a host terragucci cannot name.

url.description: Where the project lives, for a forge not on https or the default port.

gate.description: When a wave waits for an approval.

approval.description: What counts as a waiting wave's approval.

locks.description: When a pull request takes its root locks.

waves.description: The canary wave, the jobs one wave spreads across, and extra apply order.

drift.description: A cron schedule for tf-drift, or false.

synth.description: The command that writes the roots before any job reads them.

steps.description: Commands run before or after a root's init, plan, apply and drift.

image.description: The image every job runs in, built FROM terragucci's.

notify.description: The secrets holding Slack, Teams or webhook addresses, and the relay's name.

cost.description: Cost estimates per root in the plan note.

comments.description: GitLab only: the cron of the comments schedule, or false.

rollouts.description: A cron schedule for the job that opens each rollout's next wave, or false.

gitlab.description: GitLab only: how the project keeps its forge token.

reports.description: A bucket for plan reports: s3://, gs:// or az://.

token_env.description: The environment variable holding the forge token.

env.description: Environment variables every job gets. Values only, never secrets.

runner.description: The runner each job runs on: a label, a list of labels, a GitHub runner group, or one per stage.

pass.description: Names of CI secrets and variables the plan, apply and drift jobs get.

telemetry.description: The secret holding OTLP headers, and a trace link with {trace_id}.

modules.description: Module publishing, attestation and the module registry.

oidc.description: Cloud identities the jobs take over OIDC: a read-only one for plan, a write one for apply.

parallelism.description: How many roots of one dependency layer plan at once.

atlantis_comments.description: Read atlantis plan and atlantis apply comments as terragucci's.

respond.description: The response to each pipeline event.

agent.description: The coding agent behind /terragucci agent and the drift agent.

review.description: A model's review of each pull request's intent against its plan.

audit_region.description: The AWS region whose CloudTrail drift attribution reads.

dashboards.description: Dashboards and alert rules written next to the pipeline.

own_jobs.description: Jobs of your own, in the forge's syntax, or the path of a YAML file holding them.

ephemeral.description: Roots each pull request gets a copy of.
